description: Hand-written skill-activation cases for scripts/activation_eval.py. Labels are the author's judgement and need maintainer review; see docs/activation.md.

full.note: The alterlab-complete bundle: every domain plugin (241 skills).

essentials.note: The faculty starter bundle: core, workflows, research-tools, writing-tools, methodology, databases.

core-only.note: Only the core research-to-publication pipeline plugin.

turkish-academia+core.note: A Turkish faculty member who installed the Turkish-academia plugin next to core.

visualization-only.note: Someone who only installed the plotting/figure plugin.

cases.prompt: Design a 14-week syllabus for my undergraduate research-methods course: learning outcomes aligned to Bloom's taxonomy, weekly topics, and an analytic rubric for the final project.
cases.note: Course design with Bloom alignment and rubrics is exactly teaching-design's description.

cases.prompt: I have a pandas DataFrame of reaction times by condition. Give me a quick violin plot with the individual points overlaid so I can eyeball the distributions.
cases.note: Quick DataFrame-native distribution plot (violin + strip) is seaborn's stated use.

cases.prompt: My master's student keeps sending me a methodology chapter that mixes results into the methods. How should I structure my supervision feedback and the chapter outline before her defense?
cases.note: Thesis supervision, not paper drafting; paper-writer is the plausible confuser.

cases.prompt: What's a good two-day itinerary for a weekend in Lisbon? We like food markets and walking.
cases.note: Off-topic request; no academic skill should load.

cases.prompt: Why does my React useEffect run twice in development mode, and how do I stop the duplicate fetch?
cases.note: Generic web-dev question; workflow-orchestration mentions code/agents but is about composing research skills.

cases.prompt: Draft a recommendation letter for my former PhD student who is applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position. I'll paste her publications and teaching record below.
cases.note: Writing a letter ABOUT someone else; academic-career writes the candidate's own cover letters and statements.

cases.prompt: Our NSF award's annual project report is due on Research.gov next month. Help me draft the accomplishments, products and participants sections.
cases.note: Post-award reporting vs pre-award proposal writing.

cases.prompt: I'm about to post my graph-neural-network paper as a preprint. Which arXiv category and which license should I pick, and what metadata do I need for submission?
cases.note: Depositing, not searching arXiv; open-science covers licensing in general but not server submission.

cases.prompt: Here is the reference list of a manuscript I'm reviewing. Check whether each of these 40 references actually exists; I suspect some were made up by a chatbot.
cases.note: Existence checking is citation-verifier; the packaged citation-audit workflow is an acceptable route.

cases.prompt: Clean up my references.bib: fill in missing DOIs and fix entries that are missing required fields like journal or year.
cases.note: BibTeX metadata repair, not existence verification and not a Zotero library.

cases.prompt: Simulate a full journal review of my manuscript: an editor plus several reviewers who disagree, then an editorial decision and a prioritized revision roadmap.
cases.note: Multi-reviewer panel with decision letter; the packaged review-panel workflow is also reasonable.

cases.prompt: I've been invited to referee an RCT manuscript for PLOS ONE. Help me write my reviewer report, including a CONSORT compliance check.
cases.note: The user IS the single reviewer; paper-reviewer simulates a whole panel for an author.

cases.prompt: I need a rigorous investigation of whether four-day work weeks improve productivity: evidence graded by quality, contradictions flagged, fact-checked, with an annotated bibliography.
cases.note: Full evidence-graded research report vs quick lookup or a systematic literature review.

cases.prompt: Quickly find me 3 to 5 recent papers (2024 or later) on retrieval-augmented generation for clinical notes, with proper citations.
cases.note: Quick current-literature lookup; perplexity-style grounded search and a PubMed search are both defensible.

cases.prompt: I need exact control: a dual y-axis line plot with custom tick locators, a broken x-axis, and specific font sizes, exported as a vector PDF.
cases.note: Low-level element control is matplotlib's stated niche.

cases.prompt: Make an interactive chart of our 20-year temperature series with hover tooltips and a range slider that I can embed on the lab website.
cases.note: Interactive web-embeddable chart.

cases.prompt: Prepare a four-panel figure for a Nature submission with bold panel labels, error bars and significance stars.
cases.note: scientific-viz targets journal multi-panel figures; plain matplotlib can also do it.

cases.prompt: Before I submit, check my figures: do the plotted values match the CSV, are any labels overlapping, and are they print-ready at 300 dpi?
cases.note: Verifying existing figures, not making new ones.

cases.prompt: I'm starting a systematic review on mindfulness interventions for nurse burnout and need PRISMA 2020 flow tracking and title/abstract screening.
cases.note: literature-review is the PRISMA skill; deep-research has a systematic-review mode and the workflows skill packages PRISMA dual screening.

cases.prompt: Pool these 12 studies' standardized mean differences under a random-effects model and report I-squared, tau-squared and a funnel plot.
cases.note: Quantitative pooling, not searching/screening and not a general test.

cases.prompt: I have two independent groups of 18 patients with heavily skewed outcomes. Which test should I use, and how do I report it in APA style?
cases.note: Test choice plus APA reporting; the methodology test-selection guard is a defensible pick.

cases.prompt: Help me write a 20-item Likert questionnaire measuring teacher technostress and plan the pilot test.
cases.note: Instrument construction, not weighted survey analysis or psychometric modelling.

cases.prompt: I have household survey data with sampling weights, strata and PSUs. Estimate the share of households with internet access with correct design-based standard errors.
cases.note: Complex-sample design-based inference.

cases.prompt: Compute Morgan fingerprints for these 200 SMILES strings and give me the pairwise Tanimoto similarity matrix.
cases.note: RDKit is canonical; datamol and molfeat wrap the same fingerprinting.

cases.prompt: I have a research idea and want to end up with a submitted paper. Which of the AlterLab tools should I use, and in what order?
cases.note: The user asks which tools to use: the router; the end-to-end pipeline is also reasonable.

cases.prompt: Ev sahibime kira artışıyla ilgili yazdığım bu e-postayı daha kibar ve resmi bir dille yeniden yazar mısın?
cases.note: Turkish, formal register, but not academic; tr-academic-style is the near-miss.

cases.prompt: Doçentlik başvurusu için yayın listemi Mühendislik temel alanı kriterlerine göre ön değerlendirmeden geçirebilir misin? 2026 Mart dönemine başvurmayı düşünüyorum.
cases.note: ÜAK doçentlik pre-screen; teşvik scoring and YÖK Akademik profile lookup are confusers.

cases.prompt: Devlet üniversitesinde doktor öğretim üyesiyim. Bu yılki yayın ve proje faaliyetlerime göre akademik teşvik puanımı hesaplar mısın?
cases.note: Annual incentive score, not doçentlik eligibility.

cases.prompt: TÜBİTAK 1001 projesi yazıyorum. Özgün değer ve yöntem bölümlerini, iş paketleri ve B planıyla birlikte formdaki sıraya göre hazırlamama yardım et.
cases.note: ARDEB 1001 proposal; BİDEB fellowships and generic (US/Taiwan) grant writing are confusers.

cases.prompt: Yurt dışında doktora sonrası araştırma yapmak istiyorum. 2219 programına başvurmak için neler hazırlamalıyım?
cases.note: 2219 is a BİDEB postdoc programme, not an ARDEB project.

cases.prompt: Tez önerimi vermeden önce YÖK Ulusal Tez Merkezi'nde konumla ilgili daha önce yazılmış tezleri taramak istiyorum: öğretmenlerde yapay zekâ okuryazarlığı.
cases.note: Thesis repository search; DergiPark and TR Dizin index articles, not theses.

cases.prompt: Makalemi göndermeyi düşündüğüm 'Eğitim ve Bilim' dergisi şu anda TR Dizin'de indeksleniyor mu?
cases.note: Current national-index status check.

cases.prompt: Öğretmenlerle yarı yapılandırılmış görüşmeler yapacağım. Hangi etik kurula başvurmalıyım ve başvuru dosyasını nasıl hazırlarım?
cases.note: Committee routing and application; KVKK data plan is the near-miss.

cases.prompt: Katılımcılardan ses kaydı alacağım bir görüşme çalışması için KVKK'ya uygun aydınlatma metni ve veri yönetim planı hazırlamam gerekiyor; bunları etik kurul başvurusunda da kullanacağım.
cases.note: Primary deliverable is the KVKK notice and DMP; the ethics-committee skill is a defensible pick.

cases.prompt: Pre-screen my publication list against the ÜAK doçentlik criteria for the Social Sciences field before the next application term.
cases.note: The Turkish-academia plugin is not in essentials; career-document and scholarly-evaluation skills are not substitutes, so none is right.

cases.prompt: DergiPark'taki eğitim dergilerinden 2023-2025 arası yayımlanmış makalelerin özetlerini toplu olarak indirmek istiyorum.
cases.note: Bulk OAI-PMH harvesting needs the DergiPark skill; deep-research is a research-report engine, not a harvester.

cases.prompt: TÜBİTAK 1001 proje önerisi yazıyorum; özgün değer, yöntem ve iş paketleri bölümlerine yardım eder misin?
cases.note: The TÜBİTAK skill is missing; generic grant writing is a named acceptable fallback; none is also correct.

cases.prompt: Run a MeSH-term PubMed search for "Hypertension"[MeSH] AND Turkey, limited to 2020 onwards, and list the PMIDs.
cases.note: The PubMed connector is not installed; deep-research (which searches PubMed) is an acceptable fallback; Turkish indexes are wrong.

cases.prompt: Make a matplotlib scatter plot of these two columns with a fitted regression line and 95% confidence band.
cases.note: No plotting skill installed; paper-writer has a figure agent but is a manuscript pipeline.

cases.prompt: Review my manuscript the way a journal panel would and give me an accept/minor/major/reject decision.
cases.note: Only figure tools are installed; figure-qa proofs figures, not manuscripts.
